title: Death Mountain Trail
caption: The summit is the trail's northern end: the Great Fairy of magic and Din's Fire is behind the wall you bomb to the left of Kaepora Gaebora.

title: Hyrule Castle
caption: The castle grounds as a child. The Great Fairy of the spin attack is by the path up, where it turns left past the gatehouse.

title: Zora's Fountain
caption: The fountain with Lord Jabu-Jabu in the middle. The Great Fairy of Farore's Wind is behind the cracked wall in the south corner.

title: Death Mountain Crater
caption: The crater as an adult. The Great Fairy of doubled magic is in a cave blocked by rocks you break with the Megaton Hammer, past the bridge south of the exit to Goron City.

title: Desert Colossus
caption: The plain in front of the Spirit Temple. The Great Fairy of Nayru's Love is behind the cracked wall on the north side.
